toolbar.title: List toolbar
toolbar.body: Search, filter, choose the columns and undo or redo changes here. Whatever you change in the list is saved according to the entity's configuration.

search.title: Quick search
search.body: Type to search on the server. Press “/” from the list to jump here and Esc to clear it.

filters.title: Filters
filters.body: Each active filter is a tag you can remove. Filters, sort order and search are kept in the page address: you can copy or share it.

columns.title: Columns
columns.body: Show or hide columns, change their order and pin them to the start or the end. You can also drag a header or resize it from its edge. It is remembered for you.

table.title: The list
table.body: Move with the arrow keys, edit with Enter or F2 (or by typing over the cell) and cancel with Esc. Tab takes you out of the list and Shift+Tab brings you back to the cell you were on; only while editing, Tab confirms and moves to the next cell. Double-click on a row, or Ctrl+Enter, opens the record in edit mode. Ctrl+Z undoes and Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V copy and paste cells.

row-actions.title: Row actions
row-actions.body: Each row has its own menu with what can be done to it. If you select several rows a bar appears to do it on all of them at once.

batch-bar.title: Pending changes
batch-bar.body: When there are unsaved changes, this bar counts them. Save with Ctrl+S or discard them; each row is saved separately and the ones that fail are reported.

idle.title: Changes bar
idle.body: It appears when you edit: once there are unsaved changes it counts them and lets you save or discard them all at once with Ctrl+S.

undo.title: Undo and redo
undo.body: Every change you make in the list can be undone and redone, also with Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Shift+Z. The buttons turn on as soon as there is something to undo.
